Overview of Offered Devices
Home Monitoring Products:
Blood pressure units, clinical thermometers, pulse oximeters, and blood glucose meters.
Safety & Mobility Aids:
Personal emergency alarms for the elderly, rollators, wheelchairs, and bathroom safety equipment.
General Care Equipment:
CPAP accessories, pressure care cushions, and everyday home-care consumables.
